Test Case 2: GET /v2/impulses/:id - Retrieve Impulse with Multi-Tenant Filtering

Input:
  endpoint: GET /v2/impulses/test-impulse-retrieve-002?project_id=project-impulse-retrieve
  headers: { Authorization: Bearer {token} }

Expected Output:
  status: 200
  response: {
    impulse_id: 'test-impulse-retrieve-002',
    api_key: string,
    project_id: 'project-impulse-retrieve',
    impulse_data: {...},
    created_at: ISO8601 timestamp,
    updated_at: ISO8601 timestamp
  }
  multiTenantIsolation: Cannot retrieve with different project_id (returns 404)
